description: Generate the PTBuilder JavaScript for the current topology. Tell the user to open a new, empty Packet Tracer workspace (File > New), open Extensions > Builder Code Editor, paste the script and click Run. Runs validation first: errors block generation unless force: true. The script is the first text block; warnings, if any, are a second text block.

force.description: Generate even if validation reports errors.

name: generate_script
title: Generate PTBuilder script
